        • OptionalarticleNumbers?: string[] | null

          Description

          Filter for orders which contains at least one of these article numbers.

        • OptionalbackOrderForOrderId?: number | null

          Description

          Only return orders which are back orders for the order with this order ID.

        • OptionalconsigneeOrderNumbers?: string[] | null
        • OptionalcustomerEmail?: string | null
        • OptionalcustomerNumber?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders for the specified customer number.

        • OptionalcustomerTelephoneOrMobileContains?: string | null
        • goodsOwnerId: number

          Description

          Goods owner ID.

        • OptionalgoodsOwnerOrderId?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders whose Goods Owner Order ID match this.

        • OptionallastPackingTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been packed on since this time.

        • OptionallastPackingTimeTo?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been packed before this time.

        • OptionallastPickingTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been picked on since this time.

        • OptionallastPickingTimeTo?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been picked before this time.

        • OptionallastReturnedFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been returned on since this time.

        • OptionalmarketPlace?: string | null
        • OptionalmaxOrdersToGet?: number | null

          Description

          The maximum number of orders to return.

        • OptionalonlyIfTransportPrinted?: boolean | null

          Description

          Only return orders where the transport documents have been printed.

        • OptionalonlyOrdersWithOrderLinesToReport?: boolean | null

          Description

          Only return orders where there are order lines with ReportedNumberOfItems < PickedNumberOfItems.

        • OptionalonlyOrdersWithOrderLinesToReportReturned?: boolean | null

          Description

          Only return orders where there are order lines where ReportedReturnedNumberOfItems is less than the actual number of returned items.

        • OptionalorderCreatedTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been created after this time.

        • OptionalorderCreatedTimeTo?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been created before this time.

        • OptionalorderFreeText1?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders whose order freetext1 match this.

        • OptionalorderHeaderUpdatedTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders where the header information has been updated after this time.

        • OptionalorderHeaderUpdatedTimeTo?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders where the header information has been updated before this time.

        • OptionalorderIdFrom?: number | null

          Description

          Only return orders whose order ID is greater than or equal this.

        • OptionalorderLineCommentContains?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which contain an order line whose comment contains this.

        • OptionalorderLineCommentEquals?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which contain an order line whose comment equals this.

        • OptionalorderLineSupplierNumber?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which contains order lines with articles from the given supplier. This also includes the alternative suppliers of the article.

        • OptionalorderNumber?: string | null

          Description

          Order number.

        • OptionalorderNumbers?: string[] | null
        • OptionalorderStatusChangedTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders whose status has changed after this time.

        • OptionalorderStatusFrom?: number | null

          Description

          Filter for orders whose status is greater than or equal to this.

        • OptionalorderStatusTo?: number | null

          Description

          Filter for orders whose status is lower than or equal to this.

        • OptionalorderTransportStatusCreateOrUpdatedFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders with transport status create or updated after this time.

        • OptionalorderUpdatedTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Only return orders which have been updated after this time. Note that this value must be at most 2 days old.

        • OptionalparcelNumber?: string | null

          Description

          Filter for orders which contains a pallet/package with the specified parcel number.

        • Optionalpickable?: string | null

          Description

          Filter for whether or not an order is pickable. Either 'All' or 'NotPickable' or 'NotOk'.

        • OptionalpickOrderId?: number | null

          Description

          Only return orders which belong to this pick order.

        • OptionalreferenceNumbers?: string[] | null

          Description

          Only return orders with the specified reference numbers.

        • Optionalserial?: string | null

          Description

          Filter for orders which contains an item with the specified serial number.

        • OptionalshipmentId?: number | null

          Description

          Only return orders belonging to this shipment.

        • OptionalshippedTimeFrom?: string | null

          Description

          Filter for orders which were marked as 'shipped' after this time.

        • OptionalshippedTimeTo?: string | null

          Description

          Filter for orders which were marked as 'shipped' before this time.

        • Optionalsort?: string | null

          Description

          Allows you to specify how the orders will be sorted. By default, they will be sorted by OrderId Ascending. If you set sort = "descending", then they will be sorted according to OrderId Descending.
